x: Of our second four, McGreechan showed that he is on the way back to his old form and Norman Guilmant gave clear indication that the longer distance events will find him a worthy contender.
Meanwhile, George Beecham, revelling in the sunshine, came through to fourth with Hugh McGreechan and Bob Newson completing our scoring team in 6th and 7th positions.
McGreechan. They were met by Harry Shields who went over for a few days holiday and his assistance proved very useful on the day of the race.
